correctness.rationale: Every derivation has a unique generator block A and central shear block B, with induced central block C_A on the exterior square. Idempotence imposes A²=A, C_A²=C_A and BA+C_AB=B. Upon splitting V into image U and kernel W of A, C_A has scalar eigenvalues 2, 1, 0 on wedge² U, U wedge W, wedge² W. This forces r<=1 in odd characteristic and yields an exactly countable B-space of dimension binom(n-1,2)+(n-1)^2 for r=1. In characteristic two C_A is idempotent for every projection A and B has dimension r[binom(r,2)+binom(n-r,2)]+r(n-r)^2. Projection counts {n bracket r}_q q^{r(n-r)} give the complete rank polynomial; rank is r+r(n-r), and its maximum is floor((n+1)^2/4). At r=n the number of derivations is q^{n binom(n,2)}; a finite-field Gaussian upper bound and explicit exponent gap Delta_n(s)>=sn²/4 for n>=20 prove concentration. A standalone checker independently enumerated full derivation matrices over F2,F3,F5 in n=2 and F2 in n=3, tested D²=D and computed rank by elimination, all matching the formula. Finite verification is not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Direct primary-text inspection of Benito–Roldán-López 2019 and La Rosa–Mancini 2023, plus searches for idempotent derivations, characteristic-two gradings and equivalent rank tables and comparisons with available same-family mathematical claims, found no equal or dominating derivation-rank polynomial. Previously reported counts of idempotent Lie endomorphisms of free class-two Lie algebras cannot imply these formulas: the induced central map is wedge² A for endomorphisms and A wedge I + I wedge A for derivations. The first is a multiplication-preserving condition; the latter imposes Leibniz. Prior structural derivation parameterizations are credited, and publication priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: Idempotent derivations determine binary eigenvalue structures compatible with the Leibniz rule, making their ranks and rank multiplicities intrinsic operator invariants. In the natural free class-two family the exact spectrum changes from only rank n in odd characteristic to a quadratic-in-n maximum in characteristic two, yet the overwhelmingly dominant characteristic-two stratum has rank n. This infinite-family complete invariant and structural characteristic boundary, with a quantitative concentration law, is materially different from a low-dimensional computation, arbitrary parameter slice or endomorphism count.
